label: PiCCS
requirement: Reduce K fresh CCS and k fresh-bound CE inputs to K+k CE outputs at one new point.

label: Input relation
requirement: Keep each source and relation obligation distinct.

label: Fresh CCS input
requirement: For each i<K, use the selected structure, c_i=L(Pack([x_i,w_i])), public projection x_i, norm(z_i)<b, and f(M_0*z_i,...,M_(t-1)*z_i)=0 at every Boolean row.
remaining: This is an input relation premise. The native constructor checks shape, norm and commitment, but does not replace the CCS polynomial proof.

label: Prior CE input
requirement: For each prior q<k, require selected structure, commitment/public opening, norm<b, common point r, full Eval_K coefficients, and full Eval_A coefficients for each matrix.
remaining: Valid prior openings remain a relation premise. Shared carried digests alone do not prove it.

label: Honest polynomial
requirement: Construct the paper polynomial from actual packed assignments.

label: Pad table
requirement: For each source i, coefficient ell and Boolean row X, form h_i=Emb_F(Trans_F(Pad))*z_i and its multilinear extension.

label: Matrix table
requirement: For each source i and matrix j<t, form h_i,j=Emb_L(Trans_L(M_j))*z_i and evaluate every coefficient of its multilinear extension.

label: Constant coefficients
requirement: At each Boolean row, const(h_i) recovers the scalar assignment entry and const(h_i,j) recovers the scalar matrix product M_j*z_i.
remaining: Requires the constant-term law and the same packing maps.

label: Fresh CCS polynomial
requirement: F(X)=sum(i<K) gamma^i*f(const(h_i,0(X)),...,const(h_i,t-1(X))).

label: All-source norm polynomial
requirement: NC(X)=sum(i<K+k) gamma^i*product(a=-(b-1)..b-1)(const(h_i(X))-a). With b=2, enforce roots -1,0,1 for every fresh and prior source.
remaining: Zero equivalence uses base-field zero and no-zero-divisor laws.

label: Eval_K index
requirement: For prior q in [0,k) and coefficient ell in [0,d), use I_K=q+k*ell, the zero-based form of paper I_K.

label: Eval_A index
requirement: For prior q in [0,k), matrix j in [0,t) and coefficient ell in [0,d), use I_A=q+k*j+k*t*ell.

label: Eval_K polynomial
requirement: Eval_K(X)=eq(X,r)*sum(q<k,ell<d) gamma^(q+k*ell)*coeff_ell(h_(K+q)(X)).

label: Eval_A polynomial
requirement: Eval_A(X)=eq(X,r)*sum(q<k,j<t,ell<d) gamma^(q+k*j+k*t*ell)*coeff_ell(h_(K+q),j(X)).

label: Joint polynomial
requirement: Q(X)=Eval_K(X)+gamma^(k*d)*Eval_A(X)+gamma^(k*d*(t+1))*eq(X,alpha)*(F(X)+gamma^K*NC(X)).

label: PiCCS transcript
requirement: Fix the selected Nightstream transcript inputs and order.

label: Initial absorption
requirement: Reset Poseidon2 with the digest-only v1_1 domain. Absorb the prior-state digest, then each fresh commitment and public prefix in the selected order.
remaining: The selected profile does not directly absorb the prior point/evaluations here. Retain the authenticated prior-state boundary.

label: Alpha coordinates
requirement: For each a<log2(m), derive alpha[a] using label [1,a] and the selected Poseidon2-to-K map before gamma.

label: Gamma
requirement: Derive gamma with label [2] after alpha and before the first sumcheck message.

label: Message before round challenge
requirement: For each round a, absorb its index and exact-width polynomial message; then derive r_prime[a] with label [3,a]. Honest round construction must not depend on future challenges.

label: Full opening absorption
requirement: After sumcheck, absorb all d Eval_K coefficients and all d coefficients of each Eval_A matrix for every source in order. Supply the resulting state to PiRLC.

label: Sumcheck
requirement: Check the initial value, every bounded-degree round, and the final endpoint.

label: Initial Eval_K sum
requirement: T_K=sum(q<k,ell<d) gamma^(q+k*ell)*coeff_ell(y_(K+q)).

label: Initial Eval_A sum and total
requirement: T_A=sum(q<k,j<t,ell<d) gamma^(q+k*j+k*t*ell)*coeff_ell(y_(K+q),j); T=T_K+gamma^(k*d)*T_A.

label: Round degree and exact width
requirement: Every honest round has the verifier-owned degree ceiling. The paper ceiling is max(u,2*b,2); the selected FPrime key fixes degree 9.
remaining: Requires InterpolationEvaluationLaws. Native generic shape degree must be compared with the same selected relation.

label: Round sum and update
requirement: For every round a, check p_a(0)+p_a(1)=v_a. Start v_0=T, then set v_(a+1)=p_a(r_prime[a]); reject an incorrect message width.

label: Honest Boolean sum
requirement: The Boolean-cube sum of the actual protocol polynomial equals the table Q sum used in the signed joint identity.

label: Final endpoint
requirement: Require v_logm to equal the terminal value computed from the supplied full opening message at r_prime.

label: Four terminal terms
requirement: Keep CCS, norm, Eval_K and Eval_A separate.

label: CCS terminal
requirement: F_prime=sum(i<K) gamma^i*f(const(y_prime_i,0),...,const(y_prime_i,t-1)). The selected profile has K=1.
remaining: Local theorem requires SpecHolds and equality of its named input, challenge, point and output wires.

label: Norm terminal
requirement: NC_prime=sum(i<K+k) gamma^i*product(a=-(b-1)..b-1)(const(y_prime_i)-a). Include every source.
remaining: Local theorem requires SpecHolds and equality of its named input, challenge, point and output wires.

label: Eval_K terminal
requirement: EK_prime=eq(r_prime,r)*sum(q<k,ell<d) gamma^(q+k*ell)*coeff_ell(y_prime_(K+q)).
remaining: Local theorem requires SpecHolds and equality of its named input, challenge, point and output wires.

label: Eval_A terminal
requirement: EA_prime=eq(r_prime,r)*sum(q<k,j<t,ell<d) gamma^(q+k*j+k*t*ell)*coeff_ell(y_prime_(K+q),j).
remaining: Local theorem requires SpecHolds and equality of its named input, challenge, point and output wires.

label: Final identity
requirement: Check v=EK_prime+gamma^(k*d)*EA_prime+gamma^(k*d*(t+1))*eq(r_prime,alpha)*(F_prime+gamma^K*NC_prime).
remaining: Requires component wire equalities and SpecHolds.

label: Full CE outputs
requirement: Return complete evaluations at one new common point.

label: Every Eval_K coefficient
requirement: For every source i and coefficient ell<d, output coeff_ell(MLE(h_i,r_prime)); preserve all coefficients.
remaining: Equality theorem requires a valid corrected-ambient output opening.

label: Every Eval_A coefficient
requirement: For every source i, matrix j<t and coefficient ell<d, output coeff_ell(MLE(h_i,j,r_prime)).
remaining: Equality theorem requires a valid corrected-ambient output opening.

label: Preserve source identity
requirement: Each output preserves its input structure, commitment, public prefix and witness; all outputs use r_prime.

label: PiCCS strong reduction
requirement: Separate algebraic extraction, probability, and opening assumptions.

label: Identity iff four obligation families
requirement: The formal joint identity is equivalent to every fresh CCS residual, every source norm residual, every prior Eval_K residual, and every prior Eval_A residual being zero.
remaining: Uses the stated algebra and coefficient-map laws; a sampled zero is not a formal polynomial identity.

label: Mixing root event
requirement: If a source obligation is false but the sampled residual vanishes, expose the nonzero residual polynomial and the sampled alpha/gamma root.

label: Fixed-width sumcheck failure
requirement: An accepted fixed-width probe with an invalid source yields a source proof, a mixing root or the concrete fixed-phase bad challenge event.
remaining: Requires accepted probe, degree coverage, algebra/lift/constant laws, b=2 and valid corrected-ambient output witness.

label: Source extraction or bad event
requirement: Use accepted probe and valid corrected-ambient output openings to recover source membership, or the named mixing/sumcheck failure. The extractor returns the fresh witness suffix.
remaining: This is a conditional deterministic reduction. It does not prove an efficient probabilistic extractor.

label: Same phi in repeated probes
requirement: For one input statement, any pair of output probes has exactly the same ordered commitment projection phi.

label: Mixing and sumcheck probability bounds
requirement: Discharge the paper mixing bound (k*d*(t+1)+2*K+k-1+log2(m))/|Kfield| and sumcheck bound max(u,2*b,2)*log2(m)/|Kfield|, then the conditional expected-time extraction argument.
remaining: Degree and named-event reductions exist. They do not give selected Poseidon2 Fiat-Shamir event probabilities or the Appendix B.2 expected-time extractor.

label: Actual and native links
requirement: Connect PiCCS local semantics to selected rows and real native inputs.

label: Selected rows imply exact PiCCS phase
requirement: For arbitrary selected logical RowsZero and their actual public boundary, decode PiCCS and establish the exact selected-key phase and hashes.
remaining: This covers PiCCS. The theorem does not populate later PiDEC proof messages.

label: Actual native assignment to Lean polynomial
requirement: For a nonzero assignment and selected matrices/key, connect native packing, honest polynomial, causal rounds and full outputs to the same Lean protocol data and export.
remaining: Existing synthetic fixture parity and recorded honest diagnostics do not close the selected Compiler/Conformance gate.

label: PiRLC
requirement: Combine all PiCCS CE claims and witnesses using small ring challenges.

label: PiRLC inputs
requirement: Use exactly the ordered PiCCS output batch.

label: Exact PiCCS batch
requirement: Input i is exactly PiCCS output i, with the same selected structure, common new point, commitment, public prefix, full Eval_K and full Eval_A.
remaining: The local theorem uses PiCCS phase in one semantic environment; arbitrary decoded values need a separate bridge.

label: Exact profile sampler
requirement: Obtain the ring challenges from the verifier-owned outgoing transcript.

label: Exact PiCCS outgoing state
requirement: Start sampling from the state after the full PiCCS opening message. A carried digest must not replace transcript replay.
remaining: The local theorem requires PiRLC phase and equality of the actual initial state.

label: Source domain and order
requirement: For source i=0..16, absorb [4,i] into the previous source state. Use fresh-then-running order.

label: Fixed digest window
requirement: For each source, use exactly eight digest blocks. Each contributes four current rate lanes before permutation. Advance eight blocks even if 54 coefficients were already accepted.

label: Canonical candidate order
requirement: For each canonical Goldilocks rate word, take bits [0,16) then [16,32), in block and lane order. There are 64 candidates per source.

label: Reject exactly 65535
requirement: For each 16-bit candidate v, prove accept iff v!=65535. The circuit checks quotient-bit Booleanity, quotient recomposition, division and remainder equations.

label: Accepted symbol
requirement: For each accepted candidate v, output exactly v mod 5 using the same decoded candidate and acceptance bit.

label: First accepted positions and shortfall
requirement: For each ell<54, output acceptedSymbols[ell] in candidate order. Require at least 54 accepted candidates; otherwise return failure.

label: Centered ring coefficients
requirement: For each source i and ell<54, rho_i[ell]=acceptedSymbol_i[ell]-2 in F, embedded in the fixed Phi81 order.

label: Challenge membership
requirement: Every sampled rho has all coefficients in {-2,-1,0,1,2}. Keep membership distinct from equality to the actual verifier-derived rho.

label: Exact response and final state
requirement: The local phase response equals key.piRlcChallenges at its initial state; its outgoing state equals the batch final state.
remaining: Requires the complete local phase and the same environment. Arbitrary selected rows still need R.connection.challenges.

label: Public combination
requirement: Use the identical ordered rho family for every component.

label: Commitment sum
requirement: For each commitment coordinate a, c_prime[a]=sum(i<K+k) action(rho_i,c_i)[a].
remaining: The local theorem requires the corresponding input, challenge and output wire equations.

label: Public-prefix sum
requirement: For each public ring coordinate a, x_prime[a]=sum(i<K+k) rho_i*x_i[a].
remaining: The local theorem requires the corresponding input, challenge and output wire equations.

label: Eval_K sum
requirement: For each Eval_K coordinate a, y_prime[a]=sum(i<K+k) lift(rho_i)*y_i[a].
remaining: The local theorem requires the corresponding input, challenge and output wire equations.

label: Eval_A sum
requirement: For each matrix j and evaluation coordinate a, y_prime_j[a]=sum(i<K+k) lift(rho_i)*y_i,j[a].
remaining: The local theorem requires the corresponding input, challenge and output wire equations.

label: Exact combined claim
requirement: Return one combined-stage CE claim with unchanged structure and point and the exact four public sums.

label: Combined witness
requirement: Construct the parent opening and prove its combined bound.

label: Witness sum
requirement: For each packed witness coordinate a, z_prime[a]=sum(i<K+k) rho_i*z_i[a]. Its public prefix equals the public sum.

label: Strict parent bound
requirement: Valid small challenges and source norm<b imply norm(z_prime)<B. For the selected 17-source profile, the actual coefficient bound gives 17*216<65536.
remaining: This finite convolution bound is for admitted fresh assignments and admitted five-symbol challenges, not a universal norm-ratio theorem.

label: Parent CE opening
requirement: The combined assignment opens the combined commitment, public prefix, Eval_K and Eval_A at the common point and satisfies the strict combined norm bound.

label: Perfect completeness and public coin
requirement: For valid input openings and valid public challenges, the honest response succeeds; it adds no private verifier coin.
remaining: This theorem quantifies over valid challenges. Fixed-window sampler shortfall is separate.

label: Weak extraction
requirement: Separate fork algebra, sampling probability and relaxed binding.

label: Successful coordinate forks
requirement: For each source i, supply a successful fork that changes only rho_i, keeps all other challenges equal, and supplies valid combined openings for the base and fork.
remaining: CompleteFork is an extraction input, not a proof that an efficient sampler obtains it.

label: Each extracted assignment
requirement: For each i, delta_i=rho_i-rho_i_fork and z_i=delta_i^(-1)*(z_prime-z_prime_fork). The strong-set law supplies the inverse.
remaining: Requires ExtractionAlgebra, CompleteFork and StrongSetUnits. Low-norm invertibility remains a foundation assumption.

label: Extracted commitment and public opening
requirement: For each source i, cancel the two combined equations to derive L(z_i)=c_i and L_in(z_i)=x_i.

label: Extracted Eval_K
requirement: For each source i and Eval_K coordinate a, linearity and delta_i inversion give MLE(h_i,r)[a]=y_i[a].

label: Extracted Eval_A
requirement: For each source i, matrix j and evaluation coordinate a, linearity and delta_i inversion give MLE(h_i,j,r)[a]=y_i,j[a].

label: Corrected ambient bound
requirement: Every extracted field representative has centered magnitude <floor(q/2)+1. For odd q this expresses the paper rational strict bound <q/2; do not substitute the incorrect Nat bound <floor(q/2).

label: Same-phi uniqueness or collision
requirement: Two successful fork extractions with the same commitment projection give equal source witnesses or a relaxed-binding collision with differences norm<2B, delta1*c=L(v1), delta2*c=L(v2), and unequal cross-products.
remaining: The generic theorem requires UniquenessBridge. The fork-specific theorem supplies the collision from its forks. Negligible collision probability is separate.

label: Efficient fork probability
requirement: Discharge the paper expected-time coordinate extractor and its loss (K+k)/|C| and oracle-call bound; treat fixed-window sampler shortfall as a separate event.
remaining: Fork algebra exists. The cited NIFS theorem exposes a forking-failure branch and proves no probability bound for it.

label: Actual rows and native parity
requirement: Identify actual rho with exact sampled rho and preserve one sampler owner.

label: Actual parent sums
requirement: For arbitrary selected rows and their actual public marker, prove the actual commitment, public, Eval_K and Eval_A parent sums against the actual PiCCS values.
remaining: This theorem uses actual rho coefficients but does not identify them with verifier-derived rho.

label: Actual rho equals verifier rho
requirement: From arbitrary selected RowsZero and actual public input, prove decoded rho_i equals exact key.piRlcChallenges for every source and coefficient, starting at the actual PiCCS outgoing state.
remaining: Ordinary-row custody is available. The full sampler bridge still requires PiCCS and sampler Encodes, endpoint and ordinary rows, canonical Poseidon semantics, First54 SourceHolds, and scope facts. Canonical raw Encodes does not cover arbitrary selected assignments.

label: Native sampler conformance
requirement: Compare each source domain, digest block, canonical candidate, accepted position, centered coefficient, shortfall outcome and final sampler state with the same Lean computation.
remaining: Scoped tests exist. This review ran no tests; these fixtures do not by themselves prove full native NIFS conformance.

label: Extra native projection update
requirement: Resolve native projection_schedule against the selected Lean outgoing sampler state and state which transcript state is observable.
remaining: Native code adds a transcript update after rho and combination. Projection data is absent from NIFS outputs, PiDEC draws no challenge, and the next PiCCS resets. This is a schedule difference; no output mismatch or exploit was established.

label: PiDEC
requirement: Split one combined CE parent into k fresh-bound CE children.

label: Witness split and child message
requirement: Build each child from the bounded signed radix split.

label: Each witness digit
requirement: For each parent packed coefficient a, split its centered value into sign and k radix-b digits. Child t receives digit t. Selected b=2 and k=16.

label: Child commitment
requirement: For each t<k, form z_t=Pack([x_t,w_t]) and send c_t=L(z_t).

label: Child Eval_K
requirement: For each child t and coefficient ell, send coeff_ell(MLE(Emb_F(Trans_F(Pad))*z_t,r)).

label: Child Eval_A
requirement: For each child t, matrix j and coefficient ell, send coeff_ell(MLE(Emb_L(Trans_L(M_j))*z_t,r)).

label: Verifier public split
requirement: The verifier owns the parent bound, sign, digits and public recomposition.

label: Strict parent public bound
requirement: For every centered parent public coefficient a, require magnitude(x_parent[a])<B before split. Return no output on an out-of-range value.

label: Sign Booleanity
requirement: For each public scalar, enforce Boolean sign and use that same sign for all its digits.

label: Binary digit equations
requirement: For each public scalar a and t<16, enforce the binary digit equation and the sign-adjusted value assigned to child t.

label: Public recomposition
requirement: For each a, x_parent[a]=sum(t<16) 2^t*x_t[a], using the same sign and digits as the verifier-owned bounded split.

label: Verifier equations
requirement: Check arities, recomposition and exact output construction.

label: Parent and child shape
requirement: Require combined-stage parent, exactly k messages, selected evaluation arity for parent and each child, common point and selected structure.

label: Commitment recomposition
requirement: For each commitment coordinate a, c_parent[a]=sum(t<k) b^t*c_t[a].

label: Eval_K recomposition
requirement: For each Eval_K coordinate a, y_parent[a]=sum(t<k) b^t*y_t[a].

label: Eval_A recomposition
requirement: For each matrix j and evaluation coordinate a, y_parent,j[a]=sum(t<k) b^t*y_t,j[a].

label: Acceptance and rejection
requirement: Accept iff bound, stage, arity, commitment and evaluation equations hold. Any failed public check gives no output.

label: Exact child tuple
requirement: Child t has fresh stage, parent structure and point, message commitment/evaluations, and the public prefix computed by verifier split digit t.

label: Local circuit phase
requirement: PiDEC SpecHolds implies PhaseHolds with computed child output and the exact public checks.

label: Reduction of knowledge
requirement: Use valid child openings to recover a bounded parent opening.

label: Honest valid children
requirement: A valid combined parent opening gives accepted honest split messages and valid fresh-bound child CE openings.
remaining: Requires parentCombined, a valid parent opening and PiDEC algebra laws.

label: Recompose child openings
requirement: Given acceptance and valid CE openings for every output child, return their radix witness recomposition as a parent CE opening.
remaining: Requires valid child openings and k>0. It does not extract those openings from commitments alone.

label: Recomposed parent bound
requirement: Child norms<b give norm(sum(t<k)b^t*z_t)<=b^k-1<B=b^k, with the matching public split.

label: Parent identity or binding collision
requirement: For valid supplied parent and child openings with accepted public parent, the supplied witness equals recomposed child witnesses or gives a parent-opening binding collision.
remaining: Removing the collision alternative requires a commitment binding assumption.

label: Obtain child openings
requirement: Supply valid openings for all k verifier-produced children or expose child-opening failure. The public PiDEC equations alone do not supply child witnesses.
remaining: A later proof layer must discharge this premise. The deterministic NIFS theorem exposes failure otherwise.

label: Deterministic verifier
requirement: PiDEC introduces no new random challenge; it checks bound, split and recomposition.

label: Actual and native links
requirement: Identify actual parent, messages and output with the exact NIFS values.

label: Arbitrary-row PiDEC phase
requirement: For arbitrary selected RowsZero and actual public boundary, decode the PiDEC arithmetic environment and establish its local PhaseHolds.
remaining: This theorem needs no canonical Encodes premise. Exact NIFS parent and message identification are separate.

label: Actual parent equals NIFS parent
requirement: Identify the actual decoded PiDEC parent with key.parentForChallenges computed from the exact PiCCS outputs and exact verifier rho.
remaining: Compose the actual sums with exact rho and input identifications. Canonical phase wiring is not itself this arbitrary-row equality.

label: Actual messages fill NIFS proof
requirement: Decode every actual child commitment, Eval_K and Eval_A coordinate into the NIFS proof; prove key.piDecAttempt equals that actual attempt.
remaining: withDecodedPiCCS replaces PiCCS fields and retains template PiDEC fields. Finish the actual message decoder and exact coordinate equalities.

label: Computed output equals carried output
requirement: After attempt identification, prove verifier-computed children equal the actual carried output state, including split public prefixes, commitments and both evaluation families.
remaining: The carried-state projection and local phase output are proved in their own environments. Finish their equality through the exact attempt bridge.

label: Native PiDEC conformance
requirement: Compare native accepted/rejected attempts and every computed child with the same Lean bounded split and recomposition.
remaining: Scoped fixtures exist. Some use zero relation/key and solved child messages; they do not prove actual production witness openings.

label: NIFS composition and security
requirement: Compose the three phases with one selected profile and one authoritative input boundary.

label: Selected structure and bounds
requirement: Bind one Nightstream Goldilocks profile and one relation.

label: Selected CCS identity
requirement: Use one matrix family M_j and polynomial f with matching dimensions, packing and public projection. The production key fixes ProductionRelation.polynomial; native generic CCS conformance must use that same relation.

code.symbol: unused binding and expected matrix digest parameters

remaining: Size checks and caller-carried digests do not prove selected matrix identity. Preserve the existing compiler owner.

label: Production dimensions
requirement: Use selected 28-round FPrime shape, 14 matrices, ring degree 54, complete coefficient families, commitment/public widths and logical-to-padded carrier layout.
remaining: Native generic shape support does not prove the selected FPrime shape.

label: Fixed source and child counts
requirement: Use K=1, k=16, 17 PiCCS/PiRLC sources and exactly 16 PiDEC children for the selected step.

label: Nightstream binary decomposition profile
requirement: Use b=2, k_rho=16, B=b^k=65536. Global maxFresh=287 admits total<=303; the selected FPrime step uses one fresh source. Enforce the actual coefficient growth bound.
remaining: This is Nightstream Goldilocks k_rho=16, not paper Appendix B.2 reference parameters. A k_rho=18 artifact needs its own exact binding and explicit requirement.

label: Common commitment and projection
requirement: Use the same selected Ajtai key, public linear projection and compatible ring action in all phases, with paper (2B,C)-relaxed binding.
remaining: Computable commitment maps and algebra laws do not prove computational binding.

label: Common setup and encoder
requirement: PiCCS, PiRLC and PiDEC share the paper setup structure and the public/witness encoding. A phase transition must not change relation identity.

label: Input and context authority
requirement: Retain the authenticated state boundary and one transcript authority.

label: Authenticate prior state
requirement: At the caller or recursive boundary, authenticate that the prior digest names the exact running commitments, public inputs, common point, both evaluation families, iteration and context used by PiCCS.
remaining: Rust checks shared carried fold_digest and common point. Lean takes prior digest from fresh public input and ignores running during absorption. Authentication is outside this native phase. Keep an explicit authenticated-input precondition or retained proof boundary; digest self-consistency is insufficient.

label: Exact verifier-selected context
requirement: For arbitrary selected rows, prove decoded application, relation, key and domain context equal the verifier-selected context.
remaining: Actual framing preserves prior/output context fields. The verifier-bound theorem covers the constructed bound raw assignment; it is not the arbitrary-row equality to an external selected context.

label: Native execution
requirement: Trace native phase calls, opening boundary and output checks.

label: Native phase order
requirement: Native prove and verify call PiCCS, then PiRLC, then PiDEC, pass exact outputs forward and return the checked child running state.
remaining: Root ran optimized fixed 3/3 and round-trip 9/9 at this source state. Those toy inputs are zero.

label: Native witness boundary
requirement: The prover takes fresh/running witnesses, validates required shape/openings, combines them and splits the parent. It retains the resulting witness cache; the public verifier returns claims-only state.
remaining: Native entrypoints run without the FPrime exporter or fixed-point construction, but their soundness scope retains authenticated prior inputs.

label: Full native output checks
requirement: Verification recomputes the parent and public children, checks full claims and shapes, and serializes complete proof fields in the agreed order.
remaining: Current optimized round trips passed on toy zero inputs. Selected-profile nonzero conformance remains separate.

label: Local Lean composition
requirement: Connect exact phase contracts in one environment.

label: Five phase equalities
requirement: Identify PiCCS proof view, PiRLC inputs, PiRLC initial state, PiDEC attempt and PiDEC output with exact NIFS-owned values.
remaining: The canonical same-environment theorem supplies these equalities. Actual-assignment decoding must supply its premises.

label: Exact NIFS acceptance
requirement: verify returns some next iff the exact PiCCS and PiDEC checks pass and key.output equals some next. Sampler failure or unbounded public parent returns no output.

label: Arbitrary-row step closure
requirement: For arbitrary selected rows and actual public input, finish the remaining PiDEC check and exact output equality in ActualStep, then establish the verifier-selected context.
remaining: For non-base steps the existing equivalence leaves piDecCheck=true and key.output=some decoded next in decoded context. The canonical raw proof is not an arbitrary-row proof.

label: Honest three-phase transition
requirement: Valid input openings and challenges give valid PiCCS outputs, a valid combined parent and accepted fresh children in the selected profile.
remaining: PaperProfile proves algebraic realization under relation/challenge premises; it is not full native/export parity or sampler success on every state.

label: Composed security
requirement: Keep reduction contracts, exact alignment, efficient extraction and probability assumptions distinct.

label: Definition 16 obligations
requirement: Require completeness, public coin, expected-polynomial extraction to the relaxed source relation, fixed phi consistency, and same-phi witness agreement except negligible collision probability.
remaining: Local completeness, public coin and collision alternatives are proved. Efficient extraction and negligible failure remain separate obligations.

label: Definition 17 obligations
requirement: Require completeness, public coin, same output phi with probability one, and expected-polynomial source extraction under successful relaxed-output extraction and witness-agreement premises.
remaining: The deterministic source-or-event theorem does not discharge the expected-time and probability quantifiers.

label: One phi for composition
requirement: The PiCCS output commitment projection is exactly the projection used by PiRLC extraction, including public-coin suffix replay.
remaining: The theorem connects the exact NIFS probe and batch to supplied complete forks; it is not the full probabilistic composition theorem.

label: Exact fork alignment
requirement: Require CompleteFork base challenges and response to equal the exact sampled PiRLC result and exact PiCCS batch of the accepted NIFS proof.
remaining: Alignment is explicit proof data; unrelated successful forks do not satisfy it.

label: Knowledge or named failure
requirement: An accepted NIFS proof gives source/parent/child knowledge, or mixing failure, sumcheck failure, parent binding failure, PiRLC forking failure, or PiDEC child-opening failure.
remaining: This is a deterministic case split. It does not bound failure probabilities or construct efficient fork/child extractors.

label: Computational relaxed binding
requirement: Supply negligible relaxed-binding collision probability for the selected Ajtai modulus, dimensions, norm bound and strong challenge set.
remaining: A deterministic equality theorem does not establish computational collision resistance.
